1970 film directed by Vincente MinnelliOn a Clear Day You Can See Forever is a 1970 American musical comedy drama fantasy film starring Barbra Streisand and Yves Montand and directed by Vincente Minnelli. The screenplay by Alan Jay Lerner is adapted from his book for the 1965 stage production of the same name. The songs feature lyrics by Lerner and music by Burton Lane. The plot follows a hypnotherapist who discovers that his meek patient has an enigmatic past life as a 19th century aristocrat and begins to fall in love with her.
